subject: pine branches in gentle rain
pose: branches low, slope rising from bottom

composition: Native vertical 1024x1536 phone wallpaper. Design the full tall canvas with convincing depth, elegant leading lines and a strongly resolved focal scene in the middle and lower areas. Leave the upper roughly 20% naturally quiet for a lock-screen clock, using open sky, mist, water, a wall or a gentle color field; do not draw any clock or UI. Do not put essential faces or details at the extreme sides. Use a full-bleed rectangular composition, no border, no circular frame. Let scale, texture, atmosphere and beautiful lighting create the impact. Preserve clarity instead of filling every area with ornament.
creative_direction: Compose deep-teal pine branches over a low stone-colored paper slope. Add only a few diluted ink rain strokes near the branches, keeping the design mostly flat and spacious. Soft cut-paper shadows provide subtle depth at the bottom. The pale gray-green field above stays quiet, creating a fresh graphic interpretation of rain without dense lines, storm clouds or scenic clutter. Vertical 1024x1536. Reserve the upper twenty percent as naturally quiet negative space, keeping detail lower in the composition. Original peaceful image, no text, branding, or watermark.
